Security Platform Engineer I – Splunk, Analytics & Automation
Carmel, IN
Full Time
Entry Level
 SHARE
At Zotec Partners, our People make it happen.          
       
Transforming the healthcare industry isn’t easy. But when you build a team like the one we have, that goal can become a reality. Our accomplishments can’t happen without our extraordinary people – the men and women across the country who make up our diverse Zotec family and help make this company a best place to work.

Over 25 years ago, we started Zotec with a clear vision, to partner with physicians to simplify the business of healthcare. Today we are more than 900 employees strong and we continue to use our incredible talent and energy to bring that vision to life.  We are a team of Innovators, Collaborators and Doers.

We’re seeking a Security Platform Engineer I to join us.

This is an entry-level role for a recent graduate who wants to learn enterprise Splunk and security data engineering from the ground up, with close mentorship and review, during a major platform migration.

Zotec runs a distributed Splunk Enterprise environment (including Enterprise Security and ITSI) alongside a small Splunk Cloud instance. We are growing our Splunk Cloud Victoria footprint to roughly 2 TB/day, with Splunk taking over hosted upgrades and patching. Our InfoSec enterprise data lake is part of the same platform.
After the migration, about half of this work shifts from running Splunk to cross-tool security analytics,integrations, and automation.

You will work from defined tasks with review of every change, and you will escalate anything outside a runbook.

What you’ll do:
Platform
Run daily health checks (ingestion, forwarder status, skipped searches, license use) and document findings.
Onboard straightforward data sources using existing add-ons, under review.
Build dashboards, reports, and saved searches from defined requirements.
Inventory apps, inputs, and content for the Splunk Cloud migration and help test content after cutover.
Analytics and Automation
Write small Python scripts and API pulls that feed team metrics, with code review.
Validate report data against its source and flag mismatches.
Onboard AI tool logs from a defined pattern.
Team
Answer basic search and data questions from the SOC and analysts.
Write and update runbooks as you learn.
Join the on-call rotation after about six months, with a senior engineer as backup.
AI Platform Data
Support onboarding and maintenance of logs from the AI tools Zotec uses (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Bedrock, and OpenTelemetry feeds) and from AI security tooling.
Help automate the data behind monthly AI usage reporting and allowed-model and shadow-AI views.
What you’ll bring to Zotec:
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
Basic scripting in Python (preferred) or PowerShell.
Linux command line and basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, ports, TLS).
Basic SQL or another query language.
Careful attention to detail and clear written communication.
Responsible handling of sensitive data, including PHI.
Preferred Qualifications
Splunk Core Certified User (free Splunk training counts) or a home lab with Splunk or another SIEM.
Internship, co-op, or lab work in IT, security, or data.
Familiarity with Git, REST APIs, or JSON.
CompTIA Security+.

At Zotec, our purpose is to make healthcare work better for everyone. We value trust, excellence, and care in how we work with our clients and each other. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, contribute ideas, and learn from experienced colleagues who want you to succeed. If that sounds like the kind of team you’d like to join, we’d like to talk with you.

Learn more about our organization, by visiting us at www.zotecpartners.com

E-Verify and Equal Opportunity Employer
